name: HS Req Facilitator Skill
headline: HS Req Facilitator Skill - AI Requirements Analysis
short_description: AI-driven tool for analyzing, clarifying, and improving business requirements. Operations teams use it to streamline workflows, reduce ambiguity, and enhance project outcomes. Integrates with Claude and connects to project management tools.
author: damienCronw

sections.overview:
HS Req Facilitator Skill automates business requirements analysis through a structured 5-stage workflow that scans code and documents, identifies ambiguities and missing information, and prompts interactive clarification. The skill integrates with Claude Code to help operations and project teams reduce scope confusion, standardize requirement documentation, and improve project outcomes. It generates enhanced requirement specifications by consolidating multiple documents and surfacing inconsistencies that might otherwise delay project execution.
Analyze and clarify vague project requirements before development begins
Identify gaps and inconsistencies in multi-document requirement sets
Generate standardized requirement specifications from raw input documents
Extract and consolidate requirements from scattered code and documentation
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/damienCronw/hs-req-facilitator-skill`
sections.usage:
```
Analyze the following business requirements for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Identify any ambiguities, inconsistencies, or missing information. Then, suggest improvements to make the requirements clearer and more actionable. Here are the requirements: [REQUIREMENTS].
```
Copy
